meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.18; also called Hariph at Neh.7.24;
Also named: cha.riph (חָרִיף "Hariph" H2756H)
§ Jorah = "he instructs"
the head or ancestor of a family who returned from Babylon with Ezra

elsewhere.note: The children of Jorah, one hundred twelve.
